# prime-tag

prime-rs: Tag component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/tag) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-tag) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/tag.md)

Tag — port of `p-tag` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup and classes match PrimeNG (`p-tag p-component` + modifiers, `data-p`, order of `children`, icon, label),
but a `<span>` is rendered instead of the `<p-tag>` host element: the theme CSS is bound to classes, not to the tag name.

Properties are `Prop`/`OptProp`; if all of them are static, the component renders ready-made values without closures and `RenderEffect`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_tag::{Tag, TagSeverity};

let html = view! { <Tag value="New" severity=TagSeverity::Success rounded=true /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-tag-success") && html.contains("p-tag-rounded") && html.contains(">New<"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-tag = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["tag"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
